paragraphs: The repair record keeps support-location cleanup and remaining plumbing or moisture tasks visible. Reinstatement will use the material prerequisites, with unexamined wall-floor contacts kept explicit in the record.

sections.heading: The remaining covered interface
paragraphs: A lower support can conceal the junction while an opening above it shows only the wall face. We will retain those different views and the access needed to evaluate the remaining interface before the client approves a wider material task.

sections.heading: Client records and approved practical notices
paragraphs: Findings, proposed changes and progress will go directly to the designated client contact. Routine occupant messages follow hiring-manager instructions and approved wording, with accurate necessary safety and access notices.

checklist: Provide current photographs of ledge supports and lower wall-floor interfaces.
Share relevant source-service and entry-restriction records.
Confirm the designated client and handling permissions.
